messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Acme dedicated pool goes live tomorrow 08:00 PDT. Can we run a final runbook pass and confirm quota/autoscale/load tests? :rocket:
Julian - Eng: I can do an infra pass at 05:30 PDT. Need to confirm the quota numbers from billing and the targeting policy.
Evan (AE): Confirmed customer committed to 300k tokens/min sustained, burst to 500k for first 2 hours. They want graceful degradation after 90% utilization.
Maya (CS): Great. @Julian please make sure autoscale has a soft-limit for burst and a fallback to smaller model variant.
Julian - Eng: Will do. Draft autoscale snippet below — feedback welcome:
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  scale_window: 60s
  target_rps_per_gpu: 1200
  max_gpus: 40
  burst_mode:
    enabled: true
    factor: 1.6
    cooldown: 300s
  fallback_model: "redwood-mini-v2"
```
Priya (SRE): Also add a schedule to prevent noisy neighbor effects during nodal maintenance windows. I'll add cluster-level limits.
Lin (QA): I'll run the traffic profile 06:00–07:30 PDT using the soak script. Sharing k6 snippet — aim for realistic mix: 70% chat/generation, 30% embeddings.
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'test'}));
  sleep(0.5);
}
```
Evan (AE): I'm coordinating a short customer run at 07:45 to validate latency SLA (p95 < 400ms). They'll use their SDK with tokenized requests.
Maya (CS): Ops checklist for tomorrow morning: confirm quota applied by billing (Evan), infra autoscale policy merged (Julian), maintenance windows blocked (Priya), QA soak results and error samples (Lin), smoke endpoint test (Maya). Anyone adding anything? :eyes: 
ops-bot: Reminder — maintenance window blocked from 04:00–10:00 PDT per request.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued for 07:00 PDT (canary-16). Logs will be posted to #eng-releases.
Julian - Eng: I'll push the autoscale PR now and tag @Priya for review. Also enabling KV cache priming for top routes to reduce burst RT.
Priya (SRE): Reviewing now. If QA sees >1% 5xx during soak, trigger fallback to smaller model and open incident.
Lin (QA): Running first pass now, will post results in this thread in 20m.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — will capture customer confirmation after their 07:45 test and post final go/no-go by 07:55. :white_check_mark:
